CustomField.description: When checked, this page is excluded from the runtime. FormTemplate_Utility appends 'Hide__c != TRUE' to the page query (except when cloning, where hidden pages are still copied), so a hidden page is never returned to the formTemplate LWC and never appears in the form, navigation, or stages overview. Use it to retire a page without deleting it or losing its sections and conditional logic. Default false.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check this to remove the page from the live form without deleting it — the runtime query skips hidden pages, so respondents never see it. Use it to retire or temporarily pull a page while keeping its sections and settings intact; uncheck to bring it back.
CustomField.label: Hide Page
